# cloudendure_blueprint (Resource)

Manages the launch blueprint of a CloudEndure machine.

Every replicated machine has exactly one blueprint. On create the provider adopts the machine's existing blueprint (if any) and applies the configured settings; CloudEndure has no API to delete a blueprint, so destroying this resource only removes it from Terraform state. Attributes that are removed from the configuration keep their last value in CloudEndure.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cloudendure_machine" "web" {
  name = "web-01"
}

resource "cloudendure_blueprint" "web" {
  machine_id         = data.cloudendure_machine.web.id
  instance_type      = "COPY_ORIGIN"
  subnet_ids         = ["subnet-0123456789abcdef0"]
  security_group_ids = ["sg-0123456789abcdef0"]
  private_ip_action  = "CREATE_NEW"
  public_ip_action   = "DONT_ALLOCATE"
  run_after_launch   = true

  tags = {
    Environment = "dr"
  }

  disks = [
    { name = "/dev/xvda", type = "SSD" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `machine_id` (String) ID of the source machine the blueprint belongs to. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `byol_on_dedicated_instance` (Boolean) Use a BYOL Windows license when dedicated tenancy is selected.
- `compute_location_id` (String) vCenter only. Compute location ID.
- `cores_per_cpu` (Number) vCenter only. Number of cores per CPU of the target machine.
- `cpus` (Number) vCenter only. Number of CPUs of the target machine.
- `dedicated_host_identifier` (String) Dedicated host identifier, used when `tenancy` is `HOST`.
- `disks` (Attributes List) AWS only. Target machine disk properties, matched to source disks by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--disks))
- `force_uefi` (Boolean) Force UEFI boot on the target machine.
- `iam_role` (String) AWS only. IAM instance profile attached to the target machine.
- `instance_type` (String) Target instance type. Possible values come from the Region object, plus the special values `COPY_ORIGIN` and `CUSTOM`.
- `launch_on_instance_id` (String) Instance ID of a target machine managed by AMS.
- `logical_location_id` (String) vCenter only. Logical location (VM folder) ID.
- `machine_name` (String) Name of the target machine.
- `mb_ram` (Number) vCenter only. RAM of the target machine in MB.
- `network_adapter_type` (String) vCenter only. Network adapter type.
- `network_interface` (String) Network interface to attach, used when `private_ip_action` is `USE_NETWORK_INTERFACE`.
- `placement_group` (String) AWS only. Placement group of the target machine.
- `private_ip_action` (String) How the private IP is assigned. Valid values: `CREATE_NEW`, `COPY_ORIGIN`, `CUSTOM_IP`, `USE_NETWORK_INTERFACE`.
- `private_ips` (List of String) Private IPs to assign when `private_ip_action` is `CUSTOM_IP`.
- `public_ip_action` (String) Whether to allocate an ephemeral public IP. `AS_SUBNET` copies the subnet setting. Valid values: `ALLOCATE`, `DONT_ALLOCATE`, `AS_SUBNET`.
- `run_after_launch` (Boolean) AWS only. Power on the target machine after launch.
- `scsi_adapter_type` (String) vCenter only. SCSI adapter type.
- `security_group_action` (String) How security groups are assigned to the target machine, e.g. `FROM_POLICY`.
- `security_group_ids` (List of String) AWS only. Security groups applied to the target machine.
- `static_ip` (String) Static (elastic) IP to attach. Possible values come from the Region object.
- `static_ip_action` (String) How the static IP is handled. Valid values: `EXISTING`, `DONT_CREATE`, `CREATE_NEW`, `IF_IN_ORIGIN`.
- `subnet_ids` (List of String) AWS only. Subnets the target machine's network interface is placed in.
- `subnets_host_project` (String) GCP only. Host project for cross-project network subnets.
- `tags` (Map of String) AWS only. Tags applied to the target machine.
- `tenancy` (String) Instance tenancy. Valid values: `SHARED`, `DEDICATED`, `HOST`.
- `use_shared_ram` (Boolean) vCenter only. Use shared RAM.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Blueprint ID.
- `recommended_instance_type` (String) Instance type recommended by CloudEndure rightsizing.
- `recommended_private_ip` (String) Private IP recommended for the target machine.
- `region` (String) ID of the target region.

<a id="nestedatt--disks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `disks`

Required:

- `name` (String) Source disk name.

Optional:

- `iops` (Number) Provisioned IOPS.
- `throughput` (Number) Provisioned throughput in MiB/s.
- `type` (String) Disk type, e.g. `SSD`, `STANDARD`, `PROVISIONED_SSD`, `COPY_ORIGIN`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Blueprints are imported by blueprint ID.
terraform import cloudendure_blueprint.web 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
